assets.label: App interface
assets.alt: Illustrative Deskflow project workspace app with organised navigation, a weekly schedule and clearly separated tasks
assets.scene: Professional modern product UI for fictional DESKFLOW project workspace. A restrained charcoal left sidebar about 17 percent width with small wordmark DESKFLOW and just four clear menu entries "Overview", "Projects", "Schedule", "Settings"; selected Schedule has subtle burnt-orange highlight. Ivory main workspace with top line "Good morning, Alex" and small circular avatar, large heading "Your week, organised." with minimal orange button "New task". Main content is spacious crisp weekly schedule titled "This week": 5 columns "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", tidy separated muted cream, sage and peach schedule blocks with ONLY short labels "Planning", "Design review", "Client call", "Launch". Below a single beautifully aligned row of 3 task cards "Website design", "Store launch", "Client portal", each with subtle progress line and tiny circular team initials. Practical UX, aligned grid, real finished software visual, readable at small sizes, no dashboard metric claims, no chart clutter, no overlapping panels. Avoid lorem ipsum and excessive small text.
